item.title: Trump administration appeals ruling to release Hudson Tunnel funds
item.description: The Trump administration appealed a court ruling to release $16 billion in federal funds for the Hudson Tunnel Project in New York and New Jersey.

item.title: Trump repeatedly claims inflation victory even as prices rise
item.description: Trump repeatedly says inflation is beaten, but voters still feel rising costs. Reuters finds mixed messaging could hurt Republicans ahead of midterms.

item.title: Trump bars cities from using road safety grants for traffic cameras
item.description: The Trump administration is barring cities from using federal road safety grants for speed and red-light cameras, citing priorities favoring drivers.

item.title: Notion of delaying retirement may overlook worker realities
item.description: CMS chief Mehmet Oz says delaying retirement could boost the economy, but critics warn the idea favors higher earners and overlooks worker realities.

item.title: Trump administration bets on strong economic performance in 2026
item.description: The Trump administration predicts a 2026 economic boom driven by tax cuts, rate cuts and regulation rollbacks, aiming to lift Republicans ahead of midterms.

item.title: Wisconsin firefighters oppose single-stair housing bill
item.description: Wisconsin firefighters are pushing back on a bill allowing six-story apartments with one staircase, citing fire and evacuation safety risks.

item.title: Historic St. Cloud mansion restored as event venue
item.description: After years of decay, the historic Foley Mansion in St. Cloud has been restored and reopened as a venue for tours, events and teas.

item.title: Minnesota Paid Leave approves 13,000 applications in first month
item.description: Minnesota’s Paid Leave program has approved 13,000 applications since launch, with most leave taken for bonding and medical needs, DEED data shows.

item.title: St. Paul Downtown Development Corp. details investment fund contributors
item.description: The St. Paul Downtown Development Corporation launched a new $30 million investment fund backed by Securian Financial and the Bush Foundation.

item.title: Owatonna approves riverfront mixed-use project phase 2
item.description: Owatonna approves TIF for Ascend South riverfront project, adding 57 apartments and 21,000 square feet of commercial space in a mixed-use development.
